production.title: Production & resources
production.allocation: Workers choose jobs automatically by priority, skill and distance. Squad members and units with direct orders do not work colony jobs; work bots cannot operate smelters or workshops. Set priorities in the colony controls. A priority of Off prevents new assignments, not jobs already underway.
production.net_hint: Stocks / net change per simulation minute. Net change includes production, consumption, construction payments and trade; it is not gross output. Based on recent simulation time, not real time.
production.no_buildings: No production facilities or construction sites. Build a smelter, workshop or windmill from the Build menu.
production.choose: Select a facility on the left to inspect its workers and queue machines at a completed workshop.
production.queue_empty: Queue empty — select this workshop to queue a machine. Nothing is being assembled.
production.assembling:
Output: {machine} · {percent}%
Queue: {count}/5 · inputs already paid when queued.
production.windmill:
Wind → +{rate} energy / simulation min
Automatic, no worker or materials needed. Shared energy stock is capped at {cap}; machines consume energy from it.
production.energy_full: Energy storage full — surplus generation cannot be stored.
production.no_ore: Waiting for ore: need 2 to run; stock {amount}.
production.priority_off: {priority} priority is Off — no new assignments.
production.no_operator: No eligible operator: needs a colony worker outside squads and direct orders; work bots cannot operate.
production.night: Night: eligible operators are settlers, who rest instead of operating facilities.
production.worker.on_way: assigned, on the way / approaching the work position
production.worker.operate: at the facility, assigned to operate
production.harvest_remaining: Remaining harvestable inputs → stock after delivery: {resources}
production.no_nodes: No matching resource nodes remain in these zones. Designate a zone with trees, rock/ore/crystals or berry bushes.
production.no_gatherer: No worker currently gathering or approaching a harvest node.
production.no_farmer: Field work is waiting; no farmer currently assigned.
production.harvest_night: Night: settlers finish current gathering/farm jobs, then rest; work bots can continue.
production.queue_help: Machine queue · paid now, maximum 5 including the current machine. One operator assembles in queue order. Times are base work seconds, not arrival estimates; skill and rest affect completion. No further stock is needed for a paid order.
production.affordable: Affordable — click to pay and append to the queue.
production.queue_full: Queue full (5/5). Wait for the first machine to finish.
production.workshop_unavailable: Workshop is no longer available or construction is unfinished.
